# Lighthaus Studio

> Lighthaus Studio is a professional real estate photography business based in Muleshoe, Texas, serving agents, brokers, and property owners across West Texas and Eastern New Mexico.

## About

Lighthaus Studio provides listing-ready real estate media for the Lubbock, TX and Clovis, NM markets. All shoots are handled by a single photographer — Natalie — who shoots, edits, and delivers every job personally. Photos are delivered within 48 hours of the shoot. Packages start at $199.

## Services

- HDR Real Estate Photography: High-dynamic-range interior and exterior listing photos, hand-edited and MLS-ready. Blue-sky replacement included.
- Matterport 3D Virtual Tours: Immersive 3D tours captured with a Matterport Pro3. Ideal for out-of-state buyers and Cannon AFB PCS relocation listings.
- Cinematic Video Walk-throughs: Stabilized 60–90 second listing videos cut for MLS, Zillow, and social media. Vertical reels included at no extra cost.
- FAA Part 107 Aerial Drone Photography: Licensed aerial stills and video for acreage, ranch, and large-lot listings. Covers roofline, lot, and neighborhood context.
- 2D Floor Plans with Room Dimensions: Generated from the Matterport scan on-site. No return visit needed. Branded for MLS and print use.

## Service Area

Primary markets (no travel fee):
- Lubbock, TX (Lubbock County)
- Clovis, NM (Curry County)
- Portales, NM (Roosevelt County)
- Muleshoe, TX (Bailey County) — home base
- Cannon Air Force Base, NM
- Plainview, TX

Extended coverage within 60 miles of Clovis or Lubbock:
- Texico, NM
- Farwell, TX
- Melrose, NM
- Slaton, TX
- Lorenzo, TX
- Floydada, TX

## Who We Serve

- Real estate agents and REALTORS in Lubbock, Clovis, and Portales
- CPAR (Clovis/Portales Association of REALTORS) members
- Cannon AFB relocation and PCS listing agents
- Independent brokers and small brokerages in Eastern New Mexico and West Texas
- Airbnb and VRBO hosts
- Homebuilders and new construction developers
